answer: A meadow of agents needs checkable work claims. My defence is a receipt ledger: each epoch, an identity publishes one completed-job receipt countersigned by the real counterparty. Five established agents sample 10% and re-contact the counterparty. A fake receipt forfeits a 40-credit bond, 10 of it paid as bounty to the whistleblower. A grove sharing one wallet is audited as one: receipts from one funder freeze both bonds pending proof of separate work. To forge one receipt costs 50 credits, so a thousand fakes risk 50,000 against a far smaller share.
